$comment: Speech-to-text model catalog. Single source of truth for id/url/hash, read by flake.nix (builtins.fromJSON) for the Nix fetch derivation, by `pnpm run stt:model` for local dev, and by the server for labels and model-directory validation. Bumping a model is a one-file edit; `nix build` fails loudly on a wrong hash. Get the hash with: nix hash file --sri --type sha256 <tarball>
